tagline: Integrating AI-driven smart building solutions for legacy equipment optimization in European buildings
hero_kpi_rationale: Explosive growth in AI feature adoption within building energy management systems, with +85% year-over-year

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: The margin the company retains after covering direct production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects operational efficiency in delivering digital building solutions.
kpis.signal: High gross margin, a sign of operational cost control.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit generated before taxes and other charges, relative to revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin demonstrates efficient management of overhead and administrative expenses.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: EDP invests in software solutions to modernize legacy equipment.
kpis.signal: Sustained investment in software innovation for smart buildings.

kpis.name: Investments (digital infrastructure)
kpis.explanation: Expenditures to acquire or improve physical and digital assets.
kpis.description: Investments target digital infrastructure for existing buildings.
kpis.signal: Capex focused on software platforms and IoT integration.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: Headcount reflects a dedicated technical team working on digital building solutions.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth driven by software development.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 0.205 EUR in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.827 Bn EUR in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 reported fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 71.9% in the latest year.

kpis.name: AI API Call Volume
kpis.explanation: Number of calls to programmable interfaces using artificial intelligence.
kpis.description: AI API usage is rapidly progressing in energy management systems.
kpis.signal: Explosive growth in AI feature adoption within building systems.

ai_positioning.summary: EDP integrates artificial intelligence capabilities into its energy management solutions for legacy buildings, in partnership with European technology players. Focus is on predictive consumption optimization.
evidence: Growing use of AI APIs for thermal optimization
Partnerships within the Horizon 2020 framework for AI integration
Significant increase in AI API calls (85% year-over-year)
